bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed in the venue and will be searched prior to entry. Non-clear bags will undergo additional searches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking options and pricing details are not provided on the venue's website. Visitors are encouraged to check nearby parking facilities or use public transportation. Consider arriving early to secure parking.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Citizens House of Blues. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The Citizens House of Blues in Boston offers a variety of food and drink options, including shareable bites like jambalaya arancini and chicken wings, handhelds such as a double cheeseburger and po'boy, and desserts like bananas foster bread pudding. The drink menu features signature cocktails, draft and craft beers, and a selection of wines and sangria.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Citizens House of Blues Boston is wheelchair accessible. Guests who need accessible accommodations are encouraged to arrive 30 minutes before doors open.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office opens day of show ONLY starting one hour prior to doors.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: It is encouraged that guests who require accessible accommodations arrive 30 minutes prior to doors opening.
